description: Defines the interface and classes related to output composition in Android's SurfaceFlinger, including Output class, enumerators, and related structures.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Interface for managing output composition, including layer management, projection, color profile, and frame presentation.

classes.name: Output::OutputLayersEnumerator
classes.description: Helper class for enumerating output layers in Z order.

classes.name: Output::FrameFences
classes.description: Structure holding fences related to frame presentation.

classes.name: Output::ColorProfile
classes.description: Structure representing the color profile of the output.

classes.name: Output::CoverageState
classes.description: Structure used internally for computing visibility and coverage of layers.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the output is valid.

methods.name: getDisplayId
methods.description: Returns the display ID associated with the output.

methods.name: setProjection
methods.description: Sets the projection parameters for the output.

methods.name: setNextBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness for the next frame.

methods.name: setDisplaySize
methods.description: Sets the display size.

methods.name: getTransformHint
methods.description: Returns the transform hint used for layers.

methods.name: setLayerFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter for layers.

methods.name: setColorProfile
methods.description: Sets the output color profile.

methods.name: setDisplayBrightness
methods.description: Sets the display brightness.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a string with the current state for debugging.

methods.name: dumpPlannerInfo
methods.description: Outputs planner-specific information.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the debug name of the output.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the debug name of the output.

methods.name: getDisplayColorProfile
methods.description: Returns the current display color profile.

methods.name: getRenderSurface
methods.description: Returns the current render surface.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the raw composition state.

methods.name: editState
methods.description: Provides mutable access to the composition state.

methods.name: getDirtyRegion
methods.description: Returns the dirty region in layer stack space.

methods.name: includesLayer
methods.description: Checks if a layer or filter is included.

methods.name: getOutputLayerForLayer
methods.description: Returns the output layer for a given layer.

methods.name: clearOutputLayers
methods.description: Clears all output layers.

methods.name: injectOutputLayerForTest
methods.description: Creates and appends an output layer for testing.

methods.name: getOutputLayerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of output layers.

methods.name: getOutputLayersOrderedByZ
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for output layers in Z order.

methods.name: setReleasedLayers
methods.description: Sets the layers released this frame.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the output for the frame.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Finalizes and presents the output.

methods.name: setPredictCompositionStrategy
methods.description: Enables prediction of composition strategy.

methods.name: setTreat170mAsSrgb
methods.description: Overrides transfer function as sRGB.
